source_name: NBS – Pilier III: Výkazníctvo a zverejňovanie (poisťovníctvo / Solvency II)
why_relevant: NBS opinions/positions on Pillar III reporting and disclosure. NOISY TERM WARNING: in SK, 'Pilier III' most often refers to the Solvency II insurance pillar or the third pension pillar, not banking CRR Pillar 3. Useful as a supervisory-expectation source and as a disambiguation anchor for query design.

High-traffic Slovak lifestyle/business portal that reliably rewrites NBS quarterly bank-profit statistics for a mass audience, often within hours. Useful as a fast, free change-detection tripwire even though it is not authoritative.

CFO-level Slovak event where corporate treasury and payment-service buying decisions are discussed; a demand-side counterpart to bank-side conferences. Listing found on a third-party exhibition aggregator, so the canonical organiser page still needs to be identified.
Local reseller/marketing front for Worldline terminals in SK. Useful for observing pricing, promo terms and channel partners that never appear in group disclosure.

source_name: FinReg.sk – Slovenská pošta financial register profile
why_relevant: Secondary aggregator of Slovak financial-register data; useful cross-check on the postal operator's filings when the primary register or the PDF report lags.

source_name: Garančný fond investícií (GFI) – investor compensation scheme
why_relevant: The investment-services counterpart to FOV (Act 566/2001, §80), covering securities dealers and management companies up to EUR 50,000. NBS-supervised, and a compelled-disclosure body in the same family as FOV. I could not confirm a standalone official GFI domain in this pass — this is a pointer to a documented description while the primary site is located.

Scoring/aggregation of company financial and compliance data (registers of debtors in social/health insurance and tax). Cheap early-warning signal on distress among smaller SK fintechs and payment intermediaries that file minimal statements.

Popular-audience Slovak news site that publishes comparative roundups after the reporting season ('banks published their profits, who was the mover of the year'), which conveniently list several banks' figures in one place. Low editorial authority but useful as a discovery/roundup pointer.

Marginal but real: publishes 'TOP 5 slovenských bánk' profit rankings compiled from published results. Recorded for completeness of the sk-language media map; low credibility and should never be cited numerically.

source_name: registeructovnychzavierok.sk — explainer on Zbierka listín OR and Obchodný vestník
why_relevant: Private explainer site clarifying the division of labour between RÚZ, zbierka listín and Obchodný vestník after the 2014 reform. Useful glossary/context source; note it is NOT the official register despite the domain name — a naming trap to record.

source_name: SBA Educa — certification/examination body of the Slovak Banking Association
why_relevant: SBA-affiliated body running statutory examinations for financial intermediaries. Exam volumes, syllabi and regulation-driven curriculum changes are an indirect read on distribution-channel size and on incoming regulatory requirements affecting banks/PSPs.

source_name: Schmidt & Schmidt — Slovak financial statements retrieval & translation
why_relevant: Commercial intermediary supplying certified Slovak financial statements and register extracts with English translation. Fallback when a target's filing is only in Slovak PDF/scanned form or when a certified copy is needed for a client deliverable.

source_name: SIA NEWS - Slovak award/event coverage (secondary mirror)
why_relevant: Carries combined award write-ups (e.g. a smaller bank winning both 'Trend Banka roka' and 'Zlata minca'), which is exactly where challenger/niche SK banks get their strategy narrative into public text. Redundancy source for award outcomes not covered by the majors.

source_name: Wikipedia (EN) – Slovak Guarantee and Development Bank
why_relevant: English-language entry point that fixes the official English name and history of SZRB; useful for cross-language query construction, not as a factual source.
